pages.title: Recognizing Flames
pages.text: Eight special flames have distinct colors, cores, and surrounding effects. These floating essences can be captured in a Flame Vessel; ordinary ground fire cannot.$(br2)Approach an essence, capture it, and compare the filled vessel tooltip with the forging recipe requirements.

pages.title: Crimson and Earth
pages.text: $(bold)Crimson Flame$(): may appear when a Crimson Scale Flame Lizard dies. Its seed can also be forged from a Crimson Scale, Fire Lizard Blood, and spirit stones. Use the seed to awaken a capturable essence.$(br2)$(bold)Earth Flame$(): search underground lava or magma and exposed mountain magma vents.

pages.title: Wood and Solar
pages.text: $(bold)Wood Spirit Flame$(): may form when lightning strikes mature spiritwood.$(br2)$(bold)Solar True Flame$(): may remain after a Golden Core or stronger Metal/Fire-root cultivator dies. Some Daoist temples and ruins also offer opportunities.

pages.title: Nether and Thunder
pages.text: $(bold)Nether Yin Flame$(): may appear from high-level undead, especially flying undead.$(br2)$(bold)Thunder Flame$(): forms where an actual weapon-tribulation strike meets lava or fire. Ordinary weather lightning does not substitute for a weapon trial.

pages.title: Dragon and Heavenly
pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Flame$(): rarely remains after a Crimson Sky Flame Flood Dragon dies. Its horn, a Nascent Soul beast core, and spirit stones can also be refined into a seed.$(br2)$(bold)Heavenly Violet Flame$(): appears extremely rarely after surviving a powerful, successful weapon tribulation. Capture the resulting essence with a vessel.
